svg.title: Valuation, proposed
svg.desc: The model supplies judgments only: yearly growth and margin drivers in operating scenarios, and a discount rate plus terminal assumption per scenario. Code builds the statements, the FCFF schedules, the price path, anchors, weighted target and reverse valuation. A readiness check withholds before any model call when inputs are missing.
svg.text: Proposed (model judgment in purple, code in teal)

g.text: growth, margin (+ optional overrides) per year — AC-10
history ratios, tax, equity bridge, FRED rate — AC-1, AC-3
valuationReadiness — missing drivers, shares, price or revenue → withheld, no model call
AC-2; the reason lists each missing input
discount rate > risk-free, terminal, rationale — AC-9
NOPAT + D&A − capex − ΔNWC — AC-4, AC-5
assembleValuation: price path, anchors = terminal-year price, weighted target, returns
plus impliedOperatingMargin / impliedRevenueGrowth for reverse_valuation — AC-6, AC-7, AC-8
Same artifacts for readers: valuation_scenario_set, annual_price_target_path, reverse_valuation
banks and other non-FCFF assets keep model-built schedules, but code still assembles them — AC-11
